messages:
adeel: Heads-up — we need a temporary log unwrap/lease for incident triage (INC-2026-145). Goal: pull auth + request traces for tenant=ember for last 72h. Question: approved flow for KMS unwrap + RBAC exception? cc @sara @kevin

sara: Use the JIT/unlock flow. File the incident-log-request template (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/incident-log-request) and include exact fields/time-window. We do not allow blanket raw exports.

kevin: For Splunk access pattern, prefer saved search + ephemeral role created by infra-bot. Who are the analysts that need access?

adeel: Analysts: me + @maria. Oncall is @lin. I'll fill the template now.

lin: I can run the saved search and produce a scrubbed snapshot. Note: to correlate session tokens we may need KMS unwrap for session_id decrypt. That requires extra approvals.

sara: Confirmed — KMS unwrap requires 2 approvers (sec-lead + infra-svc). We have a delegated KMS proxy that performs unwraps for approved requests so the CMK never leaves HSM. But the request must include a clear justification, minimization, and retention TTL.

maria: Suggested justification text: "Triage potential auth bypass affecting ember tenant; need session and token traces to map lateral movement and identify compromised keys."

sara: Also include minimization: exact fields (session_id, user, src_ip, action, headers), time window (72h), and tenant id. Default TTL for extracted snapshots is 30d in forensics-store; request any deviation explicitly.

adeel: 72h access is fine for live triage. For snapshot TTL, stakeholders asked for 90d — what's the approval path to extend from default 30d to 90d?

kevin: Extension to >30d counts as evidence retention. Need sec-lead + legal signoff. We'll route after initial triage shows need.

lin: Example saved search I'll run (will avoid raw export until unwrap approved):
```
index=auth tenant=ember earliest=-72h latest=now | table _time user src_ip action session_id request_path status
```
I'll pipe to the scrubber that strips PII before snapshot.

sara: Ephemeral role flow: infra-bot will create role `ephemeral_inc145_ember` with scope read:splunk:search and no export permissions. Role TTL = 72h + 1hr buffer. Role creation requires ticket ID in the request.

infra-bot: Creating ephemeral role requires these fields: `incident_id`, `requester`, `analysts`, `time_window`, `fields_needed`, `justification`. Use the incident-log-request form.

adeel: KMS unwrap specifics? Who runs it and where is it logged?

sara: Steps: 1) requester files ticket (SEC-LOG-UNWRAP-INC-145) using template, 2) sec-lead approves in Jira/Slack, 3) infra-svc triggers kms-proxy unwrap (we log kms:Decrypt event to audit-bucket with CMK id and ticket reference), 4) infra operator posts confirmation in thread. The proxy only unwraps ephemeral keys for the span and writes audit record.

kevin: Important: log the unwrap event to audit logs and send a webhook to #sec-ops with ticket link. Also record which principal requested the unwrap.

maria: Before any wider sharing I'll run redaction: remove IPs that belong to non-affected tenants and mask user emails. We'll include a redacted column.

adeel: Quick question on RBAC: can product engineers request read-only snapshots for debugging, or do they need a sec sponsor?

sara: Product/devs must go through a sec sponsor or incident manager; no direct unwrap or ephemeral role creation without sponsor.

lin: I'll prepare the saved search and a pre-scrubbed sample (sanitized) and attach to the Jira ticket so approvers can vet what fields are needed.

adeel: Action items recap: (1) adeel files SEC-LOG-UNWRAP-INC-145 ticket + template with minimization + TTL request, (2) lin prepares saved search and sanitized sample, (3) infra to perform KMS unwrap via proxy once approvals present and log to audit-bucket, (4) sara to loop legal for TTL >30d.

sara: Sounds good. I'll ping sec-lead for approval. Please tag me in the Jira ticket. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Note: remember to include `evidence_chain` property in the ticket for downstream chain-of-custody automation.

adeel: Filed ticket SEC-LOG-UNWRAP-INC-145: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-LOG-UNWRAP-INC-145 — added justification + fields + requested TTL=90d (pending legal).

sara: Received. I'll review and escalate to legal if needed. Keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
